name: octave-cli
title: Octave CLI
blurb: Octave CLI on plain `octave`: byte-exact counting core in a `+textstat` package, hand-rolled argv parser, dependency-free suite, environment injected as function handles

verify.name: stdin
verify.cmd:
test "$(printf 'alpha beta
gamma
' | ./bin/{{ npm_name }} -w)" = '3 -' && test "$(printf 'alpha beta
gamma delta
' | ./bin/{{ npm_name }})" = ' 2  4 23 -'

verify.name: parity
verify.cmd: mkdir -p .parity && printf 'alpha beta\\ngamma delta\\n' > .parity/p1.txt && printf 'one two three' > .parity/p2.txt && printf 'h\\303\\251llo w\\303\\266rld\\n' > .parity/p3.txt && : > .parity/p4.txt && printf 'a\\tb\\vc\\fd\\n' > .parity/p5.txt && ok=0; for file in .parity/p*.txt; do ours=$(./bin/{{ npm_name }} -l -w -c "$file" | awk '{print $1, $2, $3}'); theirs=$(wc -l -w -c < "$file" | awk '{print $1, $2, $3}'); if [ "$ours" != "$theirs" ]; then echo "mismatch on $file: ours=$ours wc=$theirs"; ok=1; fi; done; test "$ok" -eq 0
